body: Agents driven by large language models are increasingly deployed on long-horizon tasks, where they use tools and modify real workspaces. How well they perform depends as much on the harness around the model as on the model itself. Existing benchmarks measure downstream task success under a fixed harness, leaving harness engineering itself unexplored. We propose Doc2Harness, a two-stage benchmark that evaluates long-horizon harness engineering directly. In Stage 1, a build model operating inside a fixed builder harness receives an interface-only contract skeleton and a development document that consolidates behavior across twelve frontier harnesses, and then constructs a complete candidate harness in an isolated container. In Stage 2, the frozen candidate harness runs in containers separate from the construction environment, one per test case, and is driven end to end by a scripted mock model. We score each test case using four observable channels, namely the requests sent to the model, the files on disk, the process exit code, and the command output; positive controls rule out vacuous passes. Across nineteen frontier models, each evaluated with three independent builds on 328 test cases, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest pass rate at 53.05%, while the weakest model reaches 27.44%, a gap of roughly twenty-six percentage points. Even the strongest model fails nearly half of the test cases, and failures cluster around how cross-cutting functionality is split across modules. To our knowledge, Doc2Harness provides the first deterministic benchmark for measuring long-horizon harness engineering.
summaryZh: 现有基准多在固定外壳下测试智能体的下游表现，忽略了外壳工程本身对长周期任务的影响。为此，本文提出了 Doc2Harness 这一两阶段基准，用于直接评估长周期 harness 工程。在阶段一中，构建模型根据开发文档在隔离容器中构建候选外壳；在阶段二中，冻结的外壳由脚本模拟模型驱动并通过四个可观测通道（如磁盘文件、进程退出码等）进行测试。对19个前沿模型的评估显示，最高通过率仅为53.05%，表明跨模块功能切分仍是当前模型的重大瓶颈。

glossary.explanationZh: 外壳工程，指围绕核心大模型构建的用于管理工具调用、环境交互和工作流调度的周边系统与框架设计。
长周期任务，指需要模型在较长时间跨度内、经过多个步骤持续规划并执行复杂工作流的任务。
编程智能体，能够自主理解需求、修改真实代码库、运行测试并完成软件开发任务的AI系统。
确定性基准，指在相同输入和环境下能产生可复现、无随机干扰评分结果的评估标准。
纯接口契约骨架，仅定义输入输出规范而不包含具体实现细节的代码或架构骨架。
可观测通道，指在评测中用于监控和评分的多个维度，如API请求、磁盘状态、进程退出码及命令输出。
